actions.name: Setup
actions.description: Links node_modules from the main checkout when the lockfiles match (otherwise npm ci) and links env files that are missing.

actions.name: Run dev slot
actions.description: This checkout's own dev copy of the Hub (npm run hub:dev): its own slot, port and data folder.

actions.name: Check
actions.description: The web, script and Rust checks (npm run check).

actions.name: Harsh tests
actions.description: The standing harsh suite (verify/harsh): every hard case must fail on its broken state and pass on its solved one, and the run is recorded (node scripts/hub-harsh.mjs).

actions.name: Benchmark self-check
actions.description: Ash's own asks replayed as a benchmark (verify/benchmark): the recorded good answer to each must pass and every recorded shortcut must fail, so a check that stops biting shows. Recorded; an agent replay is node scripts/hub-bench.mjs --replay --driver claude.

actions.name: Ship
actions.description: Installs this checkout's checked build as the daily app, with a trial and automatic rollback (npm run hub:ship).
actions.confirm: Ship replaces the daily MonoCode Hub with this checkout's build and restarts it when it is idle. Continue?

checks.name: Project checks
checks.description: vitest, tsc, cargo fmt, clippy and cargo test from the checkout root (npm run check).
